title: Localized real cardinal packets retain order-N4 fourth mass after K1572 weighting

packet_bound.block: An odd symmetric three-dimensional Fourier cube of side n_N asymptotic to alpha N, with d_N=n_N^3 real cardinal packets.
packet_bound.exact_identity: With normalized Haar measure, each normalized product cardinal packet satisfies int |D_j|^4=[(2n_N+n_N^(-1))/3]^3.
packet_bound.one_dimensional_count: sum_s r_n(s)^2=(2n^3+n)/3, so the normalized one-dimensional fourth power is (2n+n^(-1))/3.
packet_bound.profile_transfer: On a sufficiently small fixed scaled cube the K1572 covariance square-root multiplier has a_N^2=Theta_g(N^-1) and relative oscillation O_g(alpha^2).
packet_bound.lower_bound: For alpha=alpha_g>0 small enough, L_N=sum_j int |psi_(j,N)|^4>=c_g N^4; also L_N<=C_g N^4.
packet_bound.scope_guard: The multiplier is slowly varying, not constant; the result is a fixed-g finite-cutoff packet bound and does not supply a continuum basis.
